name: Instruction For Meeting
definition: Identifies the position of the instructing party and the actions that it wants to take in relation with the meeting.

RequestedExecutionDate.name: Requested Execution Date
RequestedExecutionDate.definition: Date at which the instruction must be executed.

MeetingIdentification.name: Meeting Identification
MeetingIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to a general meeting by the party which has notified the meeting.

SecuritiesRegistration.name: Securities Registration
SecuritiesRegistration.definition: Request to register the securities for the meeting.

ParticipationRegistration.name: Participation Registration
ParticipationRegistration.definition: Request to register for participation to the meeting.

VoteInstruction.name: Vote Instruction
VoteInstruction.definition: Request to cast detailed voting instructions.

RelatedServicing.name: Related Servicing
RelatedServicing.definition: Meeting servicing process which comprises the management of meeting instructions.

MeetingAttendance.name: Meeting Attendance
MeetingAttendance.definition: Instruction containing the information on the participation of the security holder or of its assigned representative.

ProxyAppointment.name: Proxy Appointment
ProxyAppointment.definition: Request to assign a proxy for participation to the meeting.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account and balance for which the instruction is specified.
